# Used only when regenerating requirements.lock.txt (see env/README.md).
# alphagenome_research declares pyBigWig and pyranges, but nothing this project
# uses from it needs them, and they (or pyranges' ncls and sorted-nearest
# dependencies) ship prebuilt wheels for Linux only. Restricting them to Linux
# lets the lock install on Windows and macOS without a compiler.
pybigwig; sys_platform == "linux"
pyranges; sys_platform == "linux"
# orbax-checkpoint (used only to load alphagenome_research model weights) ships
# test files whose paths exceed the Windows path length limit, so pip cannot
# install it there unless long paths are enabled system-wide.
orbax-checkpoint; sys_platform != "win32"
